status: proposed; not run; Phase 4 input from packet S6 (automation envelopes)
target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07), macOS host only
common_prerequisites: Pin the Live executable and preferences hash before the sitting; fresh preferences
Retain every input file, its SHA-256, Log.txt, crash reports, screen captures of the automation lane, and any re-saved file
Disable Link, external sync and MIDI mappings; arrangement automation enabled (no override)

probes.question: Does a set open when an envelope's first event is at neither -63072000 nor 0, or when an envelope has no events, and what does the user see?
probes.existing_evidence: AListAutomation validate 0x102561a28 (s6-0001 disassembly: fcmp with 0xc18e133800000000 and #0.0; strings 0x105bcba6c/0x105bcba86) reached from AAutomationEnvelope +0x100 0x1024050d8 and AClipEnvelope +0x100 0x10245194c (s6-0003) in the post-load walk 0x101487198 started by 0x101486fe4 (s6-0002); error thrown through 0x101488e64 -> 0x10148229c
probes.why_static_insufficient: The catch site and dialog after a load-time throw were not traced (shared with PRB-N2)
probes.minimal_input: Recording Audio.als (App-Resources/Core Library/Lessons/Sets, SHA-256 af57ff8f9eb1c2c51220ef6633a58838532350d53640df5f48dc01659023c043, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, SchemaChangeCount 1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip. Track 1-Audio (AudioTrack Id 0): Mixer/Volume AutomationTarget Id 324 (Manual 1), Mixer/Speaker AutomationTarget Id 322; NextPointeeId 2776. 'Add envelope E' means: append to that track's AutomationEnvelopes/Envelopes an <AutomationEnvelope Id="0"> with EnvelopeTarget/PointeeId 324 and the stated Events, plus <AutomationTransformViewState><IsTransformPending Value="false"/><TimeAndValueTransforms/></AutomationTransformViewState>; variants: E with events (-63072000,1),(4,0.5) [control]; E with first event at Time 4 only; E with first event Time 0 then (4,0.5); E with empty <Events/>
probes.discriminating_observation: Control and Time-0 variants open; first-at-4 and empty variants are refused as corrupt; capture dialog text and Log.txt
